excerpt.zh: 我们应该继续进行探索。我推荐派一艘£science_ship£科研船去调查周围的£system£星系。让我们勇敢地航向前人所未至的领域吧！
excerpt.en: We should continue our exploration efforts. I recommend sending a £science_ship£ Science Ship to survey neighboring £system£ Star Systems. Let us boldly go where no synthetic intelligence has gone before!
